intent_snapshot.goal: merge-queue-followups S1 (#371; Spec docs/specs/merge-queue-followups.spec.md D1-D6, D9). When a Lane's change touches a declared derived-file source or output, the merge queue regenerates and checks that output in the merged tree on a clean merge, on a declared-output conflict and when the batch head is still the lane base, so a later sibling no longer parks because an earlier Lane left the output stale; a failed regeneration parks the triggering Lane as batch_integration_check_failed naming the derived entry.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/derived-files.test.ts (D1-D6): a Lane that changes a declared source without its output, merged cleanly onto a moved batch head, integrates with the output regenerated from the merged tree and passing check; a Lane that regenerated its own output on top of an integrated sibling's unregenerated source change integrates with an output reflecting both sources; when the batch head equals the lane base and the lane commit's output is stale, the candidate carries the regenerated output. Negative: a generate that fails on a clean merge refuses with batch_integration_check_failed whose message names the entry id, leaving the batch head and working tree unmoved; a generate that writes an undeclared path refuses. Bound: a Lane touching no declared source or output runs no generate, shown by a failing generator that does not fire; a Lane whose output is already current keeps today's candidate, the lane commit itself when the batch head equals the lane base. findIntegratedCandidate adopts a regenerated candidate and laneCandidateMatches refuses one whose regenerated output was altered after integration.

In tests/batch-merge-queue.test.ts (SCN-1): a two-child Parent batch in which child a changes a declared source without regenerating the output and child b regenerates the output from its own tree completes with both children integrated, no redo grant spent, and the output at the Parent tip passing the declared check.

In tests/scope-revision-contract.test.ts (D9): plugins/immune-brain/dist/drive-batch.md states at its merge-queue paragraph that derived outputs are regenerated whenever a child changes a declared source or output, and that a failed regeneration parks that child.
The Claude bundle is current and the repository typechecks.
